multiyear_covariate_cr1.note: Multi-year (>=2 yr) soil salinity CR1 model incorporating backfilled seasonal irrigation, rainfall, and drainage covariates.

adjusted_scheduling_and_tech.cyclic_robustness_note: Cyclic interaction is borderline in additive-covariate CR1 (P = 0.0494), attenuates under origin-constrained slope moderation (P = 0.0690) and when adding scheduling main effects (P = 0.2976), and yields an imprecise adjusted difference CI spanning zero; Pillar 3 uses continuous ECw*90 as baseline and unadjusted cyclic ECw*90 as an upper-bound managed sensitivity.
